articles.title: The message behind the missile China just shot rings loud and clear
articles.summary: China's military recently conducted a rare test of a ballistic missile launched from a nuclear-powered submarine into the Pacific Ocean. This significant demonstration of naval power drew strong criticism from Japan, Australia, and New Zealand. The test underscores China's advancing capabilities in strategic weaponry and raises concerns among regional powers regarding security and military expansion in the Indo-Pacific.

articles.title: 22 trains affected as heavy rains disrupt rail traffic on busy Ahmedabad–Mumbai corridor
articles.summary: Heavy rains and severe waterlogging have crippled Mumbai's Western Railway network, significantly disrupting train services. This affects one of India's busiest rail corridors, connecting Ahmedabad and Mumbai, leading to numerous cancellations and short terminations. Commuters face major travel delays due to the inclement weather impacting critical infrastructure and causing widespread disruption.

This substantial investment underscores the nation's commitment to strengthening its underwater fleet capabilities, impacting long-term defense spending and strategic interests.

articles.title: Lockheed Martin to acquire Ultra Maritime for $3.45 billion
articles.summary: Lockheed Martin is set to acquire Ultra Maritime from Advent for $3.45 billion, a move designed to significantly bolster its undersea and anti-submarine warfare (ASW) capabilities. This acquisition highlights major consolidation within the global defence industry, crucial for strengthening naval operations and security. For SSB aspirants, it underscores the continuous evolution of defence technology and strategic capabilities.

articles.title: gerrit-change-list added to PyPI
articles.summary: This describes a tool designed to recursively scan Git repositories, listing merged commits within a defined time range. It specifically uses the committer date, rather than the author date, across all found repositories. The tool also provides integration with Gerrit, offering direct patch links for detailed review, streamlining code management and tracking processes.
